payload-written-as-plain-json-modules.text: Payload written as plain JSON: modules.
Responsibilities and the direction of dependencies. Fields are in the data model, signatures in the functions model.

direction.text: PlainJson is pure and knows nothing of commands. Singular.CLI.Payload is the only module that reads a payload file. Applications call it; none calls datumFromJson or the open-datum dataFromJson on a payload file. The open-datum dataFromJson stays for decoding envelopes.

promotion.text: The mapping serves every application that stores data, so it lives in the shared library, beside the detailed schema it complements, rather than in the open-datum package. dhPayloadJson of the decoded holding is removed when the print moves to Singular.CLI.Inspect, because nothing else reads it; each application keeps providing the payload data (dhPayload).
